name: io.github.mattoddie/octopus-mcp
title: Octopus Energy (octopus-mcp)
description: Octopus Energy usage and costs, tariffs, Agile prices, bills, EV charging and Saving Sessions

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: The image serves HTTP by default; this runs it over stdio.

environmentVariables.name: OCTOPUS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Octopus API key, from Personal details → API access in your Octopus account. It starts sk_live_.

environmentVariables.name: OCTOPUS_ACCOUNT
environmentVariables.description: Your account number, like A-1234ABCD. Optional when the key can see only one account.

environmentVariables.name: OCTOPUS_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: true lets the assistant change Intelligent Octopus charging and join Saving Sessions. false is read-only.

environmentVariables.name: OCTOPUS_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to expose: account, consumption, tariffs, intelligent, octoplus, raw. Empty means all.

environmentVariables.name: OCTOPUS_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: stderr, or a file path, to record every change the assistant makes as a JSON line. A file needs a volume.
